test_title: PYST 14: Selection Post (Matric Level) - General Intelligence (Held On 20 Jun 2024 Shift 4)
subject: reasoning
question: In a certain code language, ‘WHITE’ is written as ‘FSJGX’ and 'COLOR' is written as 'SNMND'. How will ‘SHIRT’ be written as in that language?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/30dbf680205b2ac5ef3c42da1ffec8619642030da36e21c43297a3224c70e079.png] 

**‘WHITE’ is written as ‘FSJGX’,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e232702d239e311bae411cf4ba12521e59ee627cdae3596e6cf5faca00401e6.png] 

**'COLOR' is written as 'SNMND',**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/42c10508fe7fcecebb37c2a290043f093485f44bf946fd3cc87d8f15a5c5330b.png] 

Similarly,

**'SHIRT' can be coded as,**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e130c08cad497bacd076f8b439cff1939c64b1d935b51e8c0db25e2176dd8c9e.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is **"****UQJGT"**.
